| [CLAIM-830](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-830.md) v2 | New entry, not proportionality, makes BA's law | Fills a gap in the exchange "Rich Get Richer Power Laws". In logarithmic time a Barabási–Albert node grows as e^(a/2), where a = ln(t/t_i) is its log-age.
